# unraid_docker_containers (Data Source)

All Docker containers. Requires `READ_ANY` on `DOCKER`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unraid_docker_containers" "all" {}

output "containers_with_updates" {
  value = [for c in data.unraid_docker_containers.all.containers : c.names[0] if c.is_update_available == true]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `containers` (Attributes List) List of containers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers))

<a id="nestedatt--containers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `containers`

Read-Only:

- `auto_start` (Boolean) Whether the container auto-starts.
- `auto_start_order` (Number) Zero-based position in the auto-start list.
- `auto_start_wait` (Number) Seconds to wait after starting.
- `id` (String) Container identifier.
- `image` (String) Image reference.
- `is_update_available` (Boolean) Whether a newer image is available.
- `names` (List of String) Container names (with leading `/`).
- `network_mode` (String) Docker network mode.
- `ports` (Attributes List) Port mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--containers--ports))
- `state` (String) `RUNNING`, `PAUSED` or `EXITED`.
- `status` (String) Human-readable status.
- `web_ui_url` (String) Resolved web UI URL from the template.

<a id="nestedatt--containers--ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `containers.ports`

Read-Only:

- `ip` (String) Bound host IP.
- `private_port` (Number) Container port.
- `public_port` (Number) Host port.
- `type` (String) `TCP` or `UDP`.
